app.name: ONoOffice
app.tagline: Your whole company, in one place.
app.pitch: Directory, departments, requests and internal chat — no longer scattered across spreadsheets and messaging apps.

state.waking: The server is waking up, this can take up to a minute…

errorKind.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errorKind.validation: Some fields are not valid. Please check them.
errorKind.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errorKind.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errorKind.not-found: We could not find what you asked for.
errorKind.conflict: That action conflicts with the current state of the data.

departments.title: Departments
departments.emptyHint: The org tree filters the directory, and later it is what chat channels bind to. Start with one root — usually the company name or "Executive".
departments.countNote: The number beside each department counts people directly in it, not rolled up from child departments. A department with children or people cannot be deleted.
departments.loadFailed: Could not load the department tree.
departments.name: Department name
departments.parentHint: A department cannot be placed inside its own branch — that would detach the branch from the root and make it disappear from the tree.
departments.deleteBody: Remove {{name}} from the org tree. This cannot be undone.
departments.deleteRules: A department with child departments or employees cannot be deleted — including people who have left, because their profiles still point at it.

contacts.title: Directory
contacts.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, employee code or email
contacts.noneHint: Try dropping a filter, or search by employee code instead of name.

admin.title: Admin
admin.statsFailed: Could not load the numbers. Try reloading the page.
admin.planLimits: Up to 50 members · 1 GB storage · 90 days of message history.
admin.quotaHint: Hitting the ceiling blocks the matching action — creating accounts, uploading files. The bar changes tone at 80% so there is still time to act.
admin.shortcutsHint: What admins do most. The first three are live.
admin.appsHint: Turn each app on or off for the whole workspace.
admin.needsAttentionHint: A temporary password travels through chat and spoken words, and it lives until the person signs in for the first time.

noMatch.title: No article matches
noMatch.text: Try a shorter keyword, or browse the full list on the left.

missing.title: No such article
missing.text: The link may be out of date. Pick an article on the left, or go back to Help.

dashboard.pendingPasswordWhy: A temporary password lives until they first sign in. Remind them.
dashboard.noAccountWhy: Has a staff profile but cannot sign in yet.
dashboard.noProfileWhy: Can sign in but belongs to no department.

start.title: Your workspace is ready
start.text: You are the only one here so far. Next step is bringing colleagues in — you create their accounts and hand over a temporary password, since there is no mail service yet.

linkWhy.contacts: Find a colleague, their phone and department

chat.title: Chat
chat.noConversations: No conversations yet. Open the directory and message a colleague, or start a group.
chat.emptyBody: Choose a person or a group on the left to start reading.
chat.emptyThreadBody: Type the first one below. Everyone in the conversation sees it next time they open it.
